I presented on some of my work for other LIDo students at the annual iCASE gala.
It was nice to catch up with fellow students from my cohort as we enter the final year of our PhD.
It was also good to reconnect with students from other years whom I had met at events in the past.
The venue was right across from Parliament, so we took some time to take a walk and pictures during the lunch break.

You can see the slides [here](https://jonathanbinder.com/presentations/lido_icase_2025/2025-12-05_icase_gala.html).
